clue.text: I nearly gave up too soon in safe, cushy job

indicators.note: the word in tells us the I and remnant of nearly are placed inside the word for safe

parts.note: safe means secure

indicators.note: the word nearly gives up, or surrenders, a run of its letters meaning too soon

parts.note: too soon means early

explanation.surface: Someone almost quit a comfortable, well-protected post before they should have.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gave up' strips EARLY ('too soon') from 'nearly', leaving N; I plus N go 'in' SECURE.
explanation.definitionFit: A post that pays well for little or no work is the classic easy number.

clue.text: As an alternative end it's a dud

indicators.note: dud means faulty or broken, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A failed ending offered as a substitute.
explanation.definitionFit: In place of something else, in lieu, is a synonym of the phrase.

clue.text: Army Command seeing round regiment

indicators.note: round means the word for seeing is placed round the regiment's letter

parts.note: seeing, the faculty of sight, is eyesight
R is the abbreviation for regiment

explanation.surface: An army chief is looking over a regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: On parade, the order to turn the head to the right is a drill instruction.

clue.text: Residential area in N America fit for bridge players …

parts.note: up to means capable of or fit for
W and N are West and North, two of the four bridge positions

explanation.surface: An American neighbourhood suited to card players.
explanation.definitionFit: In US cities, the district away from downtown is where many people live.

clue.text: … occasionally, whenever any don't need to shuffle

indicators.note: shuffle means the letters are mixed like cards

explanation.surface: Continuing: occasionally, at any time, people needn't shuffle cards.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in "don't" is not a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: From time to time, at intervals, is a synonym phrase for sometimes.

clue.text: One of the services provided for a group of mountains

parts.note: a Mass is one of the church services
provided means if, as a condition

explanation.surface: A mountain range where some church service is held, given conditions allow.
explanation.definitionFit: A compact block of peaks forming one upland unit is the geologist's term for a mountain cluster.

clue.text: Tangle hair in bed

parts.note: to mat is to tangle
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Someone's hair gets knotted up in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The padded base you sleep on stands for the bed itself.

clue.text: Foreign resort is in a state

parts.note: a spa is a health resort

indicators.note: in means the word is goes inside the state

parts.note: NH is New Hampshire, a US state

explanation.surface: An overseas holiday town that's located in one of the states.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming from Spain is one particular kind of being from abroad.

clue.text: Coast is not encumbered with gutted fish

parts.note: not encumbered means free

indicators.note: gutted means the inside letters are removed, leaving only the outer pair

parts.note: an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: The shore is clear of the remains of cleaned fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coast' looks like the seaside noun but is the verb: to roll along without pedalling.
explanation.definitionFit: To coast is to run on without power, as a cyclist does downhill.

clue.text: Verbal agreement for a rise

indicators.note: verbal here means spoken, so the word for agreement is heard rather than read

parts.note: agreement means assent

explanation.surface: A spoken deal secures someone a pay increase.
explanation.definitionFit: A climb or upward movement is a synonym for going up.

clue.text: Calculate roughly 16 divided by one thousand

indicators.note: divided by means the word from 16 is split apart with other letters set between

parts.note: 16 down is PROPERTY, and an estate is property
one is the Roman numeral I
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A maths exercise: work out roughly what sixteen over a thousand comes to.
explanation.walkthrough: '16' points to the answer of 16 down, PROPERTY; a synonym for it, ESTATE, is the word split.
explanation.definitionFit: To reckon an approximate figure is a synonym for gauging or guessing a quantity.

clue.text: Hooligan has run off

explanation.surface: A young thug has bolted.
explanation.definitionFit: A reckless young troublemaker is a hooligan; to tear away is to dash off quickly.

clue.text: Criticise revolution that's ending in sorrow

parts.note: rev is short for revolution, as in revs on an engine
that's, meaning that is, is i.e., id est

indicators.note: ending in picks the final letter of the word sorrow

explanation.surface: Someone attacks an uprising whose outcome was grief.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess and judge a book or show critically is a synonym for appraise.

clue.text: Saw, for instance, girl returning

indicators.note: returning means the whole run of letters is turned back to front

parts.note: for instance is e.g.
Ada is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl comes back to show, say, a carpentry saw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the tool or the past of see, but it is the noun for a proverb.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old proverb or saying, a crossword-favourite sense.

clue.text: Emotion aroused by friend or foe, in fact

indicators.note: aroused means stirred up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A feeling stirred by friend or enemy, as it happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by friend or' is padding for the surface; the fodder is FOE IN FACT.
explanation.definitionFit: Fondness or warm liking is a feeling.

clue.text: Falls considered lucky

explanation.definitionFit: The Canadian part of Niagara is called the Horseshoe Falls; a U-shaped iron shoe is a traditional good-luck charm.

clue.text: A trapper's hurt — might need such surgery

indicators.note: hurt means damaged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An injured trapper may need an operation.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition completes the phrase 'spare-part surgery', the transplanting of organs.
explanation.definitionFit: Transplant operations are called spare-part surgery, and a replacement organ is what it supplies.

clue.text: Characteristic of right — heartless Tory

parts.note: right means proper or correct

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letters of Tory are taken out

explanation.surface: A typically callous Conservative is right-wing.
explanation.definitionFit: A quality or attribute that something has is one of its features.

clue.text: In truth, I entered exam for a number of mathematicians

parts.note: truth means fact

indicators.note: entered tells us the I goes into the word for exam

parts.note: an oral is a spoken exam

explanation.surface: Honestly, I sat a test along with several maths students.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a number of mathematicians' reads as a crowd of people, but means a number that mathematicians use, such as 5! = 120.
explanation.definitionFit: The product of all whole numbers up to n is a mathematician's special kind of number.

clue.text: Vessel heads for Calais, after turning back on another tack

indicators.note: heads for means the first letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: A ship sails for Calais and turns back onto a new course.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sailing boat with one mast far forward is a type of craft.

clue.text: Girl and boy in love? On the contrary

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside another
on the contrary reverses the stated order, so love goes inside the boy instead of the boy inside love

parts.note: Carl is a boy's name
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A young couple, a girl and a boy, are in love.
explanation.definitionFit: Carol is a common female first name.

clue.text: Wind instrument, round, with a keel-like ridge

parts.note: a round shape is the letter O
a carina is a keel-shaped ridge in anatomy or botany

explanation.surface: A blown instrument, rounded and with a ridge like a ship's keel.
explanation.definitionFit: A small egg-shaped flute played by blowing is a wind instrument.

clue.text: Managing to make the business sound

parts.note: Co. is short for company, a business
a ping is a sound

explanation.surface: Running a company so it is financially healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting by or handling a situation is a synonym for managing.

clue.text: About to breathe heavily, about to drop off for a moment

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means about

indicators.note: the second about means turned around, so the word for breathe heavily is read backwards

parts.note: breathe heavily means pant

explanation.surface: Someone panting hard is on the point of nodding off briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: The two uses of 'about' do different jobs: the first stands for circa, the second is a reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A short light sleep is a snooze, so the verb means to doze briefly.

clue.text: Hazards circle round an ecclesiastic

indicators.note: round means placed around, so the word for hazards is wrapped round the circle

parts.note: to dice is to gamble or hazard, so hazards means dices
a circle is shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Risks surround a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hazards' looks like a noun (dangers) but is the verb, as in dices with death.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the clergy of a bishop's district is a churchman.

clue.text: Hoop's rim replaced by something of the same form

indicators.note: replaced means the letters are moved to new places

explanation.surface: A hoop's edge is swapped for an identical-shaped piece.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry and maths, a substance or object with identical shape or structure to another is its structural twin.

clue.text: In hospital I could do with a letter …

indicators.note: in means the letters lie inside the words hospital I could

explanation.surface: A hospital patient wishes they could have a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloping printed character, as used for emphasis, is a type of letter.

clue.text: … not a short line put together by a lawyer

parts.note: taken as written
Ry is short for railway, a line

explanation.surface: A letter not assembled by a solicitor, continuing the previous clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal official who witnesses and certifies documents is a kind of lawyer.

clue.text: Drink that goes to one's head

explanation.definitionFit: A drink taken at bedtime is the night's last tipple; a cap once worn in bed literally sits on the head.
